# Ivy: the full plain-text description

Ivy is the all-in-one business platform for solopreneurs, with an AI assistant that does your busywork. It is made for solo service businesses: massage therapists, coaches, hair stylists, photographers, personal trainers, contractors, tutors, cleaners, nail techs, lash artists, estheticians, yoga and pilates teachers, tattoo artists, doulas, music teachers, consultants, dog walkers, pet groomers, real-estate agents, event and wedding planners, freelance designers, copywriters, handymen, and every other business of one.

Website: https://www.joinivy.ai
Short version of this file: https://www.joinivy.ai/llms.txt

## The idea

Most one-person businesses run on five or six separate tools: one for booking, one for invoicing, another for payments, another for email, a spreadsheet or note app for the client list, plus an AI tool on top. The friction is in the seams between them. Ivy is one workspace where every part of the business lives: bookings know about clients, clients know about invoices, invoices know about payments, and the Ivy assistant knows about everything and can quietly nudge the owner, for example "Sarah hasn't booked in three weeks; want me to send a check-in?"

Every feature ships in the one plan. There are no tiers, no locked doors and no "contact sales".

## The Ivy assistant

Ivy, the assistant, sees the owner's real numbers (revenue this month, active clients, who has gone quiet, what is overdue) and answers in plain English with specific actions, not "consider engaging your top customers" but "send Sarah a check-in; she's 22 days quiet."

- Ask anything: quiet clients, overdue invoices, this week's bookings, revenue this month.
- Delegate anything: draft invoices and quotes, book sessions, create tasks, log expenses.
- Automate in plain English: describe a rule and Ivy builds the workflow.
- Approval-gated sends: messages, invoices, contracts and campaigns are previewed before they go out. Anything that reaches a client waits for the owner's approval.
- 600 assistant messages a month are included and reset on the 1st. One message can draft, send, book or build; a meter shows where you stand. Everything else in Ivy is unlimited.
- Owners can disable the assistant site-wide from their account page.

## Booking and scheduling

- A public booking page at the owner's own link, embeddable anywhere. Clients book around real availability with no login and no back-and-forth.
- Services, packages and class capacity, with per-weekday availability and blocked time.
- Deposits, intake forms and signatures collected in the booking flow itself.
- Automated reminders by email and SMS before each appointment, at the times the owner chooses.
- Card on file, with late-cancel and no-show policies that enforce themselves.
- Up to 2 helpers can sign in to see their schedule and mark sessions done. Included.
- Google Calendar two-way sync; Apple Calendar and Outlook read-only subscriptions; day, week and month views; reschedule and cancel with notice rules.
- Virtual bookings get a private video room automatically, or the owner can use their own link.

## Money

- Payments go straight to the owner's own Stripe account at Stripe's standard processing rate. Ivy never touches the money.
- Clients can pay with cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Amazon Pay, Cash App Pay, ACH bank debit, and buy now, pay later with Klarna, Affirm and Afterpay, wherever Stripe offers them.
- Branded invoices and recurring billing with line items, tax, discounts and public pay links.
- Card on file and auto-charges.
- Memberships, packages and gift cards.
- In-person sales: show a QR code and the client pays on their phone. Cash logging built in.
- Overdue autopilot: due-soon warnings and overdue nudges.
- Goals and a finance dashboard with a Schedule-C-ready tax export, compatible with QuickBooks and Xero.

## Clients

- Unlimited clients and a pipeline (leads, active, paused) with tags and conversion analytics.
- CSV import to bring a whole client list over from other tools; duplicates are matched by email.
- Two-way client messaging: direct and group threads, photos, voice memos with auto-transcription.
- A free client portal with bookings, invoices, signed forms and messages. Free for clients, forever. Clients sign up once and use the same portal across every business they work with on Ivy.
- Automatic review requests after sessions, and referral rewards built in.

## Presence

- Website builder with custom domain: drag-and-drop pages, templates, gallery and a product store. SEO built in with traffic analytics; site forms turn visitors into leads automatically.
- Documents and legally binding e-signature: waivers, intakes and agreements from rich text or the owner's own PDFs, with multi-signer support.
- Email campaigns to all clients or tagged segments, with one-click unsubscribe compliance.
- An iPhone and iPad app on the App Store with Face ID lock and push notifications, on the same account as the web: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ivy-for-solo-businesses/id6808542331. On Android, Ivy installs from the browser with Add to Home Screen.

## Integrations available today

Stripe; in-person checkout by QR code; video meetings; Google Calendar (two-way sync); Apple Calendar (CalDAV subscription, read-only); Outlook Calendar (iCal feed, read-only); form webhooks to Zapier or any URL; an embeddable booking widget; custom domains with built-in DNS verification; CSV import; email sent from the owner's branded domain when configured (Resend); SMS booking reminders and automated SMS workflow steps (Twilio).

## Pricing

- One plan: $8.99 per week, everything included, unlimited clients, bookings and invoices, no per-seat fees.
- Annual billing: $374.99 per year, about 20% less than paying weekly.
- 14-day free trial with the whole product unlocked, $0 today. Ivy reminds you before the trial ends; cancel before day 14 and you never pay.
- No contracts and no notice period. Cancel from the account page on the web, or in Apple ID subscription settings if you subscribed on iPhone. Your data stays exportable.
- Clients pay nothing. The client portal is free for them, always.
- Switching from another tool: bring your client list over via CSV import; invoices export in QuickBooks- and Xero-compatible formats.

## Security and data

- Every workspace is fully isolated. The AI assistant can only see that workspace's data, never anyone else's.
- All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. The database runs on a US-based managed Postgres provider with SOC2 Type II compliance; application servers also run on a SOC2 Type II provider. All production infrastructure is hosted in the United States.
- Payment data never touches Ivy's servers. Client cards go straight to Stripe through Stripe's hosted checkout; Ivy sees amount, status and customer email, never the card number.
- Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Ivy cannot recover a password, only reset it through the verified email on file.
- Owners can download a complete export (client list, booking history, invoices, documents, messages) as CSV and JSON at any time from their account page, even if the subscription has lapsed.
- After cancelling, data stays available for export for 60 days, then is deleted from active and backup systems within a further 30 days.
- When the owner chats with Ivy, the request plus the relevant business context is sent to Ivy's AI model provider to generate the reply. Under Ivy's agreement with that provider, the data is not used to train models, and only what the question needs is sent.
- Ivy staff access to customer data is logged and only happens when the owner explicitly asks for support on a specific record.
- Database snapshots run automatically and can be restored to any point in the last 30 days.
- Security reports: security@joinivy.ai. Ivy responds within one business day and does not pursue legal action against good-faith research.

## Who makes Ivy

Ivy is built by a business owner, for business owners, by a small team on purpose. Support emails are answered personally. Contact: support@joinivy.ai (support), hello@joinivy.ai (general and compliance questions such as DPAs or vendor review forms), privacy@joinivy.ai (privacy).
